method_explanation.problem: Testing 28 color pairs × 4 ROIs × 3 CVD subjects = 336 comparisons without correction leads to ~17 false positives by chance (336 × 0.05)
method_explanation.solution: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction controls the expected proportion of false discoveries among all rejected hypotheses
method_explanation.implementation: Applied at two levels: (1) within each subject-ROI (28 tests), (2) globally across all 336 tests
method_explanation.reference: Benjamini & Hochberg (1995). Journal of the Royal Statistical Society, Series B.
